decks.notes: The main concept of the deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent with efficient threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect your board. The deck also utilizes powerful cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to filter through the deck and find the necessary cards. With a mana denial strategy using cards like Wasteland, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and finish off the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt opponent's mana base while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. The deck utilizes mana acceleration cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to quickly cast powerful threats like Magus of the Moon and Broadside Bombardiers. The goal is to control the tempo of the game by restricting opponent's options while maximizing damage output. Additionally, cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and The One Ring provide additional value and card advantage to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through various counterspells and removal spells, while also utilizing card advantage through card draw and recursion with Snapcaster Mage. Teferi, Time Raveler and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares provide disruption to opponent's strategies, while Stock Up helps to protect key cards in hand. The deck also includes some threats like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower to apply pressure and close out the game. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student adds card advantage and Orcish Bowmasters helps to deal with creature threats. Mystic Sanctuary is included to recur important spells.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up to cast powerful spells like Show and Tell and Omniscience to cheat out big creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. It also utilizes cards like Cunning Wish and Veil of Summer to protect its combo pieces and disrupt opponents. The inclusion of cards like Lórien Revealed and Atraxa, Grand Unifier adds additional versatility and resilience to the deck. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and control elements to secure victory.

The main focus of this Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly disrupt and control the opponent with cards like Blood Moon, Chalice of the Void, and Trinisphere while using aggressive creatures such as Broadside Bombardiers and Pyrogoyf to apply pressure. The deck also includes powerful red spells like Fury and Sundering Eruption to deal with threats efficiently. With mana acceleration from cards like City of Traitors and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to lock down the opponent's resources and win the game quickly through aggressive plays and denial of key resources.

The deck focuses on utilizing the abilities of Nadu, Winged Wisdom to combo off and win the game quickly. It includes efficient interaction like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect the combo, as well as cantrip spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to find key pieces. The deck also includes versatile creatures like Endurance and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath to disrupt opponent's strategies. The mana base is designed to ensure smooth gameplay and access to different colors for casting spells. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and execute the win condition efficiently.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by efficient counterspells like Daze and Force of Will. The goal is to control the tempo of the game, disrupting the opponent's plays with cards like Stifle and Wasteland while chipping away at their life total with burn spells like Lightning Bolt. The deck is able to quickly close out games with the powerful Murktide Regent and maintains card advantage with cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage and board control. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Narset helps to further dominate the game and shut down the opponent's options. In addition, the deck has a strong mana base with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, the deck strategy revolves around outlasting the opponent and grinding out a victory through control and attrition.

The main concept of the deck is to aggressively control the board by utilizing efficient spells like Brainstorm, Lightning Bolt, and Daze, while deploying threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Delver of Secrets, and Murktide Regent to quickly close out the game. The deck focuses on using cheap cantrips like Ponder and Mishra's Bauble to dig for key pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Will and Wasteland. The deck also includes a few versatile creatures like Brazen Borrower and Questing Druid to provide additional threats and disruption.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board through a combination of removal spells and counterspells. It also utilizes card advantage and deck manipulation to find the right answers at the right time. The creatures in the deck are either disruptive or provide card advantage to maintain control of the game. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and disrupt the opponent's resources with Wasteland. Overall, the deck aims to control the game tempo, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and outvalue them in the late game.

The main focus of this combo-reanimator deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Emrakul, then bring them back into play using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck is designed to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Unmask, while also using disruptive spells like Cabal Therapy. With the ability to cheat out massive creatures early in the game, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats before they can adequately respond.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently put powerful creatures into play from the graveyard, using cards like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Entomb. By utilizing these reanimation spells alongside cards like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats early in the game. The deck also includes disruption in the form of cards like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand and protect its own game plan. With the ability to combo off and win the game in just a few turns, this deck is a force to be reckoned with in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively disrupt your opponent's game plan by utilizing powerful mana denial effects like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void. This strategy is supported by efficient creatures like Pyrogoyf and Simian Spirit Guide, along with direct damage spells like Fury and Sundering Eruption. The deck aims to quickly establish control of the game through mana denial and powerful threats, while using cards like Chrome Mox and City of Traitors to accelerate its game plan.

This deck focuses on using the combo between Nomads en-Kor and Nadu, Winged Wisdom to draw the entire deck and win the game. It uses cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to control the game while setting up the combo. It also includes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath for additional control and value. The deck aims to assemble the combo quickly and protect it until victory is achieved.

It includes cards like Force of Will and Spell Pierce for protection and control elements. The deck aims to quickly set up the combo, cheat out big threats, and overwhelm the opponent with powerful plays. The inclusion of cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder helps to dig for combo pieces and set up the ideal hand for explosive turns.

The deck aims to control the opponent's resources with cards like Wasteland and Unholy Heat, while maintaining card advantage with Mishra's Bauble and cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm. The deck's game plan revolves around tempo plays and efficient threats, utilizing the Canadian Threshold strategy of managing the opponent's resources while steadily applying pressure to close out the game quickly.
